info.title: Fourletters API - Hub (WebSocket)
info.description: Hub endpoints for WebSocket routing and E2E message delivery

/ws.description: Main WebSocket channel for the fourletters Hub.

publish.summary: Client sends a message to the Hub

subscribe.summary: Client receives a message from the Hub

SendMessage.name: SendMessage
SendMessage.title: Send Encrypted Message
SendMessage.summary: Action wrapper to send an encrypted message over WS

ReceiveMessage.name: ReceiveMessage
ReceiveMessage.title: Receive Encrypted Message
ReceiveMessage.summary: Event wrapper pushed by the Server containing an encrypted message

AckMessage.name: AckMessage
AckMessage.title: Message Acknowledgement
AckMessage.summary: Acknowledge receipt of a message for the Store-and-Forward mechanism

MessageDispatched.name: MessageDispatched
MessageDispatched.title: Message Dispatched Receipt
MessageDispatched.summary: Event wrapper indicating the Hub successfully sent the message to the Message Broker

MessageRead.name: MessageRead
MessageRead.title: Message Read Receipt
MessageRead.summary: Event wrapper indicating the recipient has read the message
